newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Hoechst finalising pharmaceutical merger.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst finalising pharmaceutical merger.

text.p: Hoechst South Africa Ltd said on Wednesday it would soon be finalising the transaction relating to the proposed merger of its pharmaceutical business and Roussel Laboratories into a joint venture.
This follows an earlier cautionary published on December 17 about this proposed venture in which Hoechst will hold a majority equity stake.
Shareholders were advised to continue to exercise caution when dealing in Hoechst's shares until a further announcement, expected around Wednesday March 12, is made.
Hoechst's year end results are also expected to be published around this date, it said.
